page.overview:
What is Pirates?

Pirates is a 4+ theme containing larger pieces for younger children.

After the end of System in 1997 (barring several rereleases in 2001-2002), the theme was briefly revived in 2004 with a new 4+ line of Pirates sets. As with other 4+ sets, this Pirates theme features simplified builds with large specialized pieces and larger minifigures, including a reimagined version of the returning classic Pirates character Captain Redbeard.

Captain Redbeard has a rivalry with his brother and long-time enemy Captain Kragg. The story is about Redbeard and Kragg competing in a race for the treasure of Don Cortez, with each sibling holding one half of the treasure map. This theme introduced a number of minion pirates as well, including Jolly Jack Crow, Cannonball Jimmy, Harry Hardtack for the heroes, and Drake Dagger and Scurvy Dog for the villains.
